source: Hirose FH12 series catalog (2019 HI, Apr.1.2): bottom-contact 0.5mm drawing + Recommended Land/Metal Mask dimensions
footprint_local_frame: origin at signal pad-row centre; +X toward pin 14; mouth (FFC entry) toward +Y; pads on the -Y (rear) side of the housing; housing centre at local y=+1.40
pads: 14 signal pads 0.30 x 1.50 at y=-1.00, x=(k-7.5)*0.5 for k=1..14; 2 MP fitting pads 0.90 x 1.30 at x=+/-4.70, y=+1.20 (housing front corners, clear of the signal row; mechanical, NC)
uncertainty: Signal pad length (1.50) and MP pad size/row are engineering reconstructions from the catalog land tables (land width 0.30 and D span are datasheet values; the catalog text extraction does not fully resolve pad length). MP pads moved off the signal row in Rev.5 build round 1 after DRC showed overlap with pads 1/14 at the D-span positions; fitting location is a reconstruction from housing length B=10.1 (ends at +/-5.05).
